turns.text: Hello, thanks for coming in. I'm Owen's English teacher.
Hale. I know who you are. Who decided on the zero, and was it before or after anyone spoke to Owen?
Okay. Let's look at the essay.
Show me what you have. I'm not looking at an essay Owen wrote and being told it's his fault. What is it, and when is it dated?
You're very sharp, you know that?
Don't manage me. I have a client call at 4:40, so what do you have on Owen's essay?
No, really. You caught the timestamp issue in thirty seconds. That's sharp.
I haven't caught anything, Hale. You haven't shown me a timestamp or a document of any kind. Save the compliments and put the evidence on the table.
I just keep thinking, someone that sharp must see why I had to flag it.
"Had to." Procedure 4.2 says you contact the parent before any mark consequence is entered, and nobody called me. Owen saw it on his phone, in class.
